description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations, specifically generating and decrypting organization identifiers using AES encryption with a tenant-specific salt. It includes functions for converting hex strings to CryptoJS WordArrays, generating an organization ID from an email, decrypting the organization ID, and validating the tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray object.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId(email)
methods.description: Generates a URL-encoded organization ID by AES-128-ECB encrypting the normalized email with a tenant-specific salt, then encoding the ciphertext in Base64 without padding.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId(encUrlEncoded)
methods.description: Decrypts a URL-encoded organization ID back to the original email for debugging purposes, using the tenant-specific salt.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid()
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt is set and non-empty.
